thread:
Arjun Rao: Heads-up — nightly CI scan on release/v2 failed. SAST shows a couple of high-confidence findings in analytics-service (input validation) and DAST returned an auth-page 500 during crawling. Also the nightly artifact job hit a KMS decrypt 403 when fetching keystore for scanner-sa. Need quick triage + RBAC/auditlog check. @Maya @Liam
Maya Chen: link to the failing run? can you paste the scan-bot output and the keystore log lines?
Arjun Rao: Scan run: https://ci.example.com/runs/98432
scan-bot: nightly-scan 4298765432: overall: FAIL, sast: 2 high, dast: 1 medium, infra: keystore-decrypt=403 for service_account=scanner-sa
Liam Patel: copying the keystore snippet from logs: ```ERROR: kms: decrypt failed, status=403, resource=projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/decryptKey, principal=scanner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com```
Emily R.: that 403 smells like a missing IAM binding rather than KMS outage. Did we recently rotate the scanner-sa roles?
Maya Chen: I checked audit logs briefly — no recent KMS KeyRing IAM change recorded for that key in the last 7 days, but there is an IAM policy change 12 hours ago on the scanner-sa service account (roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator added). need fuller query.
Arjun Rao: ok. Priority: (1) restore scans so nightly run green, (2) triage SAST findings and DAST auth 500, (3) capture audit evidence + handoff for incident if RBAC drift found. Proposed temporary mitigation: grant scanner-sa roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on the specific key with time-limited grant (TTL 4h) while we investigate. Thoughts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ops-oncall: If we do temporary grant, annotate the grant in IAM change request and create a short-lived change with expiration via gcloud: `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding ... --condition='expression=request.time < timestamp'`? we can also pin the binder in the change ticket so it auto-removes.
Liam Patel: I'll run the auditlog query to correlate who touched bindings and whether scanner-sa lost a binding. Query I'm about to run: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName=\"SetIamPolicy\" AND resource.labels.keyRingId=\"keystore\"' --limit 50`
Maya Chen: For SAST findings — two files: analytics/input_parser.go (missing length check) and utils/unmarshal.go (unsafe cast). Quick triage: add owners, add suppression-if-fp, and create test cases. Assigning to @Emily for initial patch.
Emily R.: taking analytics/input_parser.go — will open a PR with bounds checks and unit tests. ETA 3h. Will also add a short eval to prevent regression in PR gate.
Arjun Rao: DAST 500: crawler hits /admin/login while using test credentials from staging; sounds like auth session error. @Liam can you reproduce locally with the same jar?
Liam Patel: I can reproduce the 500 when hitting crawler flow with long cookie header. Stack trace shows panic in session.Decode. Pasting snippet: ```panic: runtime error: index out of range
at session.Decode(session.go:142)
...``` Looks like unhandled nil returned from decoder. I'll wrap decode with sanity check.
scan-bot: note: re-run once keystore access fixed to ensure DAST crawler can fetch fixtures from artifact-store.
Maya Chen: Ownership + runbook items: - create an incident stub if we need cross-team blameless postmortem - add RBAC check step in nightly-run preflight (verify KMS decrypt via small smoke call) - add an auditlog correlation script to triage who changed relevant bindings - create temp IAM change using ops-oncall-approved conditional binding
ops-oncall: I'll prepare the conditional IAM grant and the rollback plan. Post the exact `gcloud` command here before applying. Also I'll add the change to our change calendar and notify infra slack channel.
Arjun Rao: tagging actions: Emily -> patch SAST (in progress). Liam -> fix DAST crash & reproduce. Maya -> auditlog correlation and open incident-stub if evidence points to unauthorized RBAC change. Ops-oncall -> prepare conditional grant and hold apply until either we confirm missing binding or we need to unblock CI.
Emily R.: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/analytics/pull/2714 (includes unit tests).
Liam Patel: PR for session guard: https://github.com/redwood/platform/pull/891 (adds nil checks + more robust cookie parsing). Requesting quick review from @Maya and @Arjun.
Maya Chen: auditlog query results: found a SetIamPolicy call by infra-automation@redwood-tools 12h ago which replaced a project-level role that indirectly removed the key-level decrypter binding (they rolled a policy using `--replace`). Opening follow-up with infra-tools to confirm intent. Evidence attached to ticket IT-4207.
Arjun Rao: if infra-automation removed it by mistake, that counts as an operational RBAC drift. We still want a postmortem doc but this is not malicious. Good that auditlogs captured it.
ops-oncall: prepping gcloud command (dry-run): ```gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member='serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter' --condition='expression=request.time < timestamp(\"2026-04-01T12:00:00Z\"),title=temporary_scan_unblock'``` Will wait for sign-off from Arjun before applying.
Arjun Rao: sign-off given. Apply it and then re-run nightly. After green, we set a follow-up: - infra-tools to revert in change IT-4207 or explain why binding was removed - update nightly preflight smoke check - add a step in our deployment checklist to avoid replace-style IAM rollouts without key-level sanity checks
Maya Chen: creating incident stub: INCIDENT-2026-04-01-scan-unblock, adding links to PRs, auditlog artifacts, and the change request. I'll capture timeline and assign postmortem owner (TBD)
Emily R.: CI re-run shows SAST failures cleared after my PR merge. DAST reproducer fixed in staging. Keystore decrypt succeeds after ops-oncall applied conditional grant. Nightly now green (scan-bot: PASS).
Arjun Rao: Great work — close loop: Maya please track postmortem, ops-oncall ensure the conditional binding auto-expires, and infra-tools to propose safer IAM rollout process. We'll review in next security triage meeting. :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: noted. I'll schedule a 30-min sync with infra-tools and ops next Tue to draft the IAM rollout guardrails and add the preflight check to the nightly pipeline.
